source: Damodaran, historical implied equity risk premiums for the United States (the FCFE-based implied premium), histimpl on his data page, transcribed 2026-10-04; each figure is the premium implied at the end of the year named
why: The point-in-time studies value past dates with the current equity risk premium table, which is a 2026 vintage. This is the premium a reader would have had at the time, so a study can say how much of what it sees is the model and how much is the vintage. Read by python/rule_variants.py only; no valuation record reads it.
